title: 第27章 针针扎心
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
日上三竿。

    青云宗外门，九区院舍。

    齐云溪收到同院室友的传讯，怀揣着疑惑一路从宗门坊市赶回六十九号院，远远便见柳树下站着一道倩影。

    沈南初背东朝西，炽盛的日光洒在身上闪闪发光，犹如穿上了圣洁的霞衣，让人看不真切脸庞。

    齐云溪走近方才认出来人是谁，不禁心中一紧，生出警惕之心。

    她加快步伐上前，躬身拱手正礼：“见过沈师姐，是师姐找我吗？”

    沈南初审视看去，嘴角翘起一丝迷人的弧度，上下打量片刻才道：“不请我进屋坐坐？”

    “哦，沈师姐里边情！”

    齐云溪摆手作请，朝前引路，睫毛连连颤动，暗自猜测对方此行的目的，直觉上肯定与苏牧有关。

    两人之间并不熟，更无私交，沈南初对齐云溪未必有多少了解，但齐云溪对沈南初却知之甚多。

    一来，沈南初姿色非常出众，战力也不弱，曾在宗门大比时拿过第七名的好成绩，在青云宗大小算个名人，很多弟子都听说过她的名字。

    二来，沈南初与苏牧走得近，尤其是尚未进入内门时，经常和苏牧一起出任务，同进同出，称得上形影不离。

    所以，齐云溪对沈南初格外关注，私下偷偷去了解过对方的信息，更知道她对苏牧有男女情愫。

    两人穿过院子，开门入得客厅，齐云溪招呼入座，然后便手忙脚乱地煮水泡茶。

    沈南初则从容自若，坐在椅子上翘起个二郎腿不住地抖动，环视着室内环境布置，目光从碗橱扫到梳妆台，从窗台上的兰花到墙角的熏香炉……

    她嘴角始终噙着若有若无的笑意，瞧不出具体意味。

    少顷，齐云溪泡好茶倒了两杯，小心翼翼端了一杯倒对方面前， 露出微笑道：“沈师姐请喝茶！”

    眼角余光瞥见敞开的门户，她犹豫一瞬，走去将门关了，并布了一道隔绝禁制，走回来后又束手站在桌前，拘谨的模样好似自己才是客人。

    沈南初将她的表现尽收眼底，心中暗自撇嘴，嘀咕道：苏牧怎会喜欢这么一个菜鸟弱鸡……

    她反客为主轻点下巴示意，笑道：“坐呀，不必师姐称呼，直接叫我名字，或者南初姐，我已经退出宗门。”

    齐云溪微怔，‘哦’了一声乖乖坐去对面，方才见对方打扮得脸蛋微黑还有雀斑，还以为是乔装要外出做任务，没想到居然退宗了。
content_en:
Three poles in the sun.

    The outer gate of Qingyun Sect, the ninth district courtyard.

    Qi Yunxi received a message from his roommate in the same hospital, and rushed back to No. 69 Courtyard from Zongmenfang City with doubts in his mind. In the distance, he saw a beautiful figure standing under the willow tree.

    Shen Nanchu turned his back to the east and faced the west. The blazing sunlight shone on his body, as if he was wearing holy rays of clouds, making his face invisible.

    Qi Yunxi only recognized who the person was when he got closer. He couldn't help but feel nervous and wary.

    She quickened her pace and stepped forward, bowed and raised her hands in a formal salute: "I have seen Senior Sister Shen. Is it Senior Sister who is looking for me?"

    Shen Nanchu looked over, with a charming curve at the corner of his mouth. He looked up and down for a moment before saying, "Don't you want me to come in and sit down?"

    "Oh, Senior Sister Shen is cheating!"

    Qi Yunxi waved his hand in invitation and led the way forward. His eyelashes trembled, secretly guessing the purpose of the other party's trip. Intuitively, it must be related to Su Mu.

    The two of them are not familiar with each other, let alone have any personal relationship. Shen Nanchu may not know much about Qi Yunxi, but Qi Yunxi knows a lot about Shen Nanchu.

    First of all, Shen Nanchu's appearance was very outstanding, and her fighting power was not weak. She once got seventh place in the sect competition. She was considered a celebrity in Qingyun Sect, and many disciples had heard of her name.

    Secondly, Shen Nanchu got close to Su Mu, especially before entering the inner gate. He often went on missions with Su Mu, went in and out together, and could be said to be inseparable.

    Therefore, Qi Yunxi paid special attention to Shen Nanchu and secretly learned about her. He also knew that she had feelings for Su Mu.

    The two of them walked through the yard, opened the door and entered the living room. Qi Yunxi greeted them to take a seat, and then hurriedly boiled water and made tea.

    Shen Nanchu was calm and composed, sitting on the chair with his legs crossed and shaking, looking around the indoor environment, his eyes swept from the cupboard to the dressing table, from the orchids on the windowsill to the incense burner in the corner...

    There was always a faint smile on her lips, but she couldn't tell the specific meaning.

    After a while, Qi Yunxi made tea and poured two cups. He carefully poured one cup in front of the other party and said with a smile: "Senior Sister Shen, please have tea!"

    She caught a glimpse of the open door from the corner of her eye. She hesitated for a moment, then walked over to close the door and set up an isolation barrier. When she came back, she stood in front of the table with her hands tied, as if she was the guest.

    Shen Nanchu took in all her performance and secretly curled his lips in his heart, muttering: How could Su Mu like such a weakling...

    She turned her back and tapped her chin to signal, and said with a smile: "Sit down, you don't need to address me as senior sister, just call me by my name, or sister Nanchu, I have withdrawn from the sect."

    Qi Yunxi was slightly startled and said "Oh" and sat down across from him obediently. Just then he saw that the other party had dressed up with a slightly dark face and freckles. He thought he was going out to do a mission in disguise, but he didn't expect that he had quit the sect.
